attribution: Wikipedia contributors credited through the article and its author history.
historicalLinks: Article titles come from the source release. Current links can redirect after a page move.

canard.source: English Wikipedia excerpts carried by QuAC into CANARD.
canard.changes: The benchmark reused excerpts from earlier turns as labeled dialogue history.
canard.linkMethod: Derived from the source article title. The dataset does not identify a specific Wikipedia revision.

tydiqa.source: Wikipedia article excerpts from the TyDiQA-GoldP v1.1 development split.
tydiqa.changes: The benchmark replays the archived passage from the source release and annotates the scored answer separately.
tydiqa.linkMethod: The archived passage keeps the article URL derived from its title and language. The dataset does not identify a specific Wikipedia revision.
